sources.title: OpenBao operator init
sources.finding: Initialization is one-time per storage backend and generates unseal material and an initial root token; neither may be committed or logged.

sources.title: OpenBao policies
sources.finding: Policies are path-based and deny by default; use separate least-privilege bootstrap and runtime policies.

sources.title: GitHub secret scanning
sources.finding: Secret scanning detects hardcoded credentials in repository history; local scanning remains necessary before any push.

sources.title: GitHub push protection
sources.finding: Push protection is preventive but must not be bypassed; P0 will not rely on it as the only scan control.

decision: Use local OpenBao initialization with operator-supplied unseal/root material, path-specific policies, and a repository-local secret scan that never embeds credentials.
limitations: No production Vault deployment, auto-unseal provider, or Product secret injection is authorized in P0.
No local container start was performed by this evidence collection.
